connector.name: Agent MCP Gateway
connector.registryDescription: On-demand tool discovery for all your MCPs and per-subagent MCP controls to preserve context window.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agent-mcp-gateway. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the roddutra account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GATEWAY_DEFAULT_AGENT

env.name: GATEWAY_DEBUG
env.description: Enable debug mode and expose diagnostic tools (default: false)
